objective: Compile a portable Academy skill that derives purpose-bound, revocable learner Passport views from consented records without exposing telemetry or collapsing capability states.

deliverables.description: An Agent Skills-compatible Passport graph projection package with explicit minimization and revocation proof.

context.audience: Learners, portfolio builders, mentors, institutions, opportunity partners, and privacy engineers

stakes.rationale: A projection can expose sensitive learner state or misrepresent competence; revocation and supersession reduce but do not erase disclosure harm.

must: Validate recipient, purpose, fields, expiry, revocation, and jurisdiction before projection.
Keep declared, practiced, demonstrated, credentialed, expired, withdrawn, and disputed states distinct.
Preserve a complete free learner-controlled export and private or self-hosted path.
mustNot: Create a universal public score, hidden risk rating, or standing recipient access.
Expose raw telemetry, chain-of-thought, behavioral inference, unrelated history, hidden assessments, or financial data.
Infer credential, reputation, ownership, or entitlement from graph adjacency.

completionTests.value: No state is inferred from graph adjacency or commercial entitlement.
